skills.name: baseline-variance
skills.title: Baseline variance
skills.description: Variance of a P6 project against its baseline or another project: finish variance, slip causes, the activities that moved most, logic changes and earned value at the data date. Use when the user asks to compare a project with its baseline or with another version.
skills.author: nizarhamza

skills.name: delay-whatif
skills.title: Delay what-if
skills.description: What-if impact of delaying one activity of a P6 project, computed in memory: the activity today, what drives it, where its float comes from, then the project finish, milestones, critical counts and the activities that move (the database is never written). Use when the user asks what happens if an activity is late or delayed.
skills.author: nizarhamza

skills.name: export-dashboard
skills.title: Excel dashboard
skills.description: Excel project controls dashboard of a P6 project (one A3 page and detail sheets), then a short summary of its cards, counts, failed DCMA checks and warnings (the database is never written). Use when the user asks for an Excel dashboard or a one-page project report.
skills.author: nizarhamza

skills.name: float-near-critical
skills.title: Float and near-critical
skills.description: Total float profile of a P6 project: float statistics, distribution by range, the float paths of the last F9 and the near-critical activities (total float above 0 and within a few days). Use when the user asks about float, near-critical work, float paths or how much float the schedule has left.
skills.author: nizarhamza

skills.name: list
skills.title: List projects by EPS
skills.description: List the projects of the database grouped by EPS, with status, data date and finish (template projects and baselines left out). Use when the user asks which projects the database holds or what an EPS contains.
skills.author: nizarhamza

skills.name: logic-date-integrity
skills.title: Logic and date integrity
skills.description: Checks that the stored dates of a P6 project follow from its logic, durations and schedule options: this server's CPM engine against the last F9, the activities whose dates differ with their probable cause, and the schedule options in force (read only). Use before pressing F9 on an imported update, or when the user asks whether the submitted dates can be trusted.
skills.author: nizarhamza

skills.name: lookahead-brief
skills.title: Look-ahead brief
skills.description: Short look-ahead of a P6 project: activities in progress, starting and finishing in the next weeks, critical ones first, by week of the window, with fixed follow-up actions. Use when the user asks what is coming up, for a look-ahead or for a short-term plan.
skills.author: nizarhamza

skills.name: milestone-tracker
skills.title: Milestone tracker
skills.description: Milestones of a P6 project against its baseline: dates, variance in working and calendar days, float and critical flags, the open milestones most late and what drives the first one; with contract milestones given, their constraints, predecessors and float origin (the database is never written). Use when the user asks about milestones, key dates, contract milestones or how the milestones compare with the baseline.
skills.author: nizarhamza

skills.name: progress-earned-value
skills.title: Progress and earned value
skills.description: Progress of a P6 project in units: % complete by every method, earned value and SPI at the data date, the S-curve per month or week against the baseline, and progress by WBS. Use when the user asks how far a project has progressed, for its earned value or SPI, or for an S-curve.
skills.author: nizarhamza

skills.name: resource-wbs-summary
skills.title: Resource and WBS summary
skills.description: Units and costs of a P6 project by resource, then activities and units by WBS and by activity status, with totals. Use when the user asks how hours, units or costs are spread over resources, WBS or status.
skills.author: nizarhamza

skills.name: schedule-quality-audit
skills.title: Schedule quality audit
skills.description: DCMA 14 quality audit of a P6 project: score and weighted grade, checks against their thresholds, engine check, trend since the previous audit, dangling ends, redundant links and float profile, with fixes proposed only. Use when the user asks to audit, check or score the quality of a schedule.
skills.author: nizarhamza

skills.name: schedule-risk
skills.title: Schedule risk (Monte Carlo)
skills.description: Monte Carlo schedule risk of a P6 project on this server's CPM engine: finish dates at p10, p50, p80 and p90, the chance to finish on time, the p80 buffer, milestones, the activities that drive the finish most often and the assumptions (read only). Use when the user asks how likely the finish date is, for a risk analysis, a confidence level or a schedule contingency.
skills.author: nizarhamza

skills.name: update-import-safely
skills.title: Update import (safe)
skills.description: Import an updated XER into an existing P6 project safely: inspect the file, dry run the update, report what it would change and what the XER lacks, then apply only on the user's explicit yes. Use when the user wants to import or load an XER update into a project.
skills.author: nizarhamza

skills.name: update-integrity-audit
skills.title: Update integrity audit
skills.description: Integrity audit of a P6 schedule update against the previous update: open ends tied to the finish, constraints removed to clear negative float, must finish date moved, actual dates rewritten, durations cut, critical links removed, link types, lags, options and calendars changed, activities deleted, data date, with the questions to raise with the contractor (read only). Use when the user asks to review or audit a submitted update, or what changed in it that needs explaining.
skills.author: nizarhamza

skills.name: weekly-update-review
skills.title: Weekly update review
skills.description: Weekly schedule update review of a P6 project: progress, finish dates, critical path, slippage against the baseline, changes since the previous update when given, progress issues and a critical look-ahead, with fixed actions (read only). Use when the user asks for a weekly update review, a status report or how a project is progressing.
skills.author: nizarhamza
